people.name: 앨런 튜링
people.quote: 인간이 AI에게 통제를 넘길 날이 머지않았습니다.
people.quoteEn: At some stage we should have to expect the machines to take control
people.quoteOrigin: At some stage therefore we should have to expect the machines to take control, in the way that is mentioned in Samuel Butler's Erewhon
linesEn: 1936 theory of computation framed the modern computer
Broke Enigma with the Bombe at Bletchley Park

people.name: 존 매카시
people.quote: AI라고 부르지도 않게 될 거요. 결국 인간과 하나가 될 테니.
people.quoteEn: As soon as it works, no one calls it AI any more
people.quoteOrigin: As soon as it works, no one calls it AI anymore
linesEn: Designed LISP in 1958, the language of early AI
Convened the 1956 Dartmouth workshop, 1971 Turing Award

people.name: 제프리 힌턴
people.quote: 역사상 처음으로 우릴 뛰어넘을 존재가 곧 등장합니다.
people.quoteEn: For the first time ever, we may have things more intelligent than us
people.quoteOrigin: I think we're moving into a period when, for the first time ever, we may have things more intelligent than us
linesEn: 1986 Nature paper made neural nets trainable
2018 Turing Award, 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics

people.name: 요슈아 벤지오
people.quote: 우린 아이들의 미래가 걸린 러시안 룰렛을 돌리고 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: We are playing Russian roulette with the future of all children
people.quoteOrigin: What really moves me is not fear for myself but love, the love of my children, of all the children, with whose future we are currently playing Russian Roulette
quoteEnChunks: with the future of all children
linesEn: Co-authored the Deep Learning textbook, most-cited scientist
Co-president of AI-safety nonprofit LawZero, 2018 Turing Award

people.name: 얀 르쿤
people.quote: AI가 인류에게 르네상스를 다시 열어줄 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: By amplifying human intelligence, AI may bring a new renaissance
people.quoteOrigin: By amplifying human intelligence, AI may bring not just a new industrial revolution, but a new renaissance, a new period of enlightenment for humanity
quoteEnChunks: AI may bring a new renaissance
linesEn: LeNet at Bell Labs read handwritten digits at scale
Former Chief AI Scientist at Meta (FAIR), 2018 Turing Award

people.name: 래리 페이지
people.quote: 결국 구글의 종착지는 하나로 수렴합니다. AI.
people.quoteEn: AI would be the ultimate version of Google
people.quoteOrigin: Artificial intelligence would be the ultimate version of Google

people.name: 세르게이 브린
people.quote: AGI를 향한 마지막 경주가 시작됐습니다.
people.quoteOrigin: Competition has accelerated immensely and the final race to AGI is afoot

people.name: 데미스 허사비스
people.quote: 먼저 지능을 해결한다. 그리고 이것으로 세상의 모든 걸 해결한다.
people.quoteEn: Step one, solve intelligence; step two, use it to solve everything else
people.quoteOrigin: Step one, solve intelligence; step two, use it to solve everything else
quoteEnChunks: use it to solve everything else

people.name: 노엄 샤지어
people.quote: 다음 단어를 예측시켰는데, 세상의 모든 걸 그려내기 시작했습니다.
people.quoteEn: Just predict the next word, and you get something that can talk about anything
people.quoteOrigin: All you have to do is predict the next word and, once you do it, you get something that can just talk to you about anything

people.name: 제프 딘
people.quote: 하나의 모델이 곧 수백만 가지의 일을 할 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: We can train a single model to do millions of things
people.quoteOrigin: Pathways will enable us to train a single model to do thousands or millions of things

people.name: 오리올 비니알스
people.quote: 우린 이미 몇몇 영역에서 초지능을 목격하고 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: We've already seen some examples of narrow but superintelligent systems
people.quoteOrigin: we honestly have seen some examples already of narrow but superintelligent system

people.name: 코라이 카북추오글루
people.quote: 혼자 학습하는 AI가 인류의 난제를 풀어낼 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: We're building technology that learns by itself and helps with things we don't even know yet.
people.quoteOrigin: What we want to build is a technology that is forward-looking, that can learn by itself, and that can be helpful on things that we don't know yet.

clusters.label: 퍼스트 무버
clusters.noteEn: The biggest beast in the game

people.name: 샘 알트만
people.quote: 인간과 AI의 융합은 이미 시작됐습니다.
people.quoteEn: The human-AI merge has already begun
people.quoteOrigin: I believe the merge has already started, and we are a few years in.

people.name: 그렉 브록만
people.quote: 우린 'AGI가 가능하다'에 베팅합니다. 맞다면 모든 게 바뀔 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: The bet is that AGI is possible, and if we are right, it will change everything
people.quoteOrigin: The fundamental bet is that AGI is possible, and if we are right about that, then it will really change everything
quoteEnChunks: The bet is that AGI is possible,
linesEn: Stripe's first CTO and first engineer

people.name: 야쿠브 파초키
people.quote: 초지능은 10년 안에 탄생할 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: Superintelligence is less than a decade away
people.quoteOrigin: We believe that it is possible that deep learning systems are less than a decade away from superintelligence
linesEn: Architected the o1 and o3 reasoning models

people.name: 마크 첸
people.quote: 모든 이가 노벨상에 도전할 수 있게 될 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: The Nobel Prize isn't for us to win. It's for everyone to win.
people.quoteOrigin: We want to allow everyone the ability to win the Nobel Prize for themselves

people.name: 피터 스타인버그
people.quote: 말 잘하는 AI의 시대는 저물고, 행동하는 AI의 시대가 옵니다.
people.quoteEn: The age of AI that just talks is over. Now it actually does things.
people.quoteOrigin: AI is shifting from large language models that are good at talking to autonomous agents designed to do.
quoteEnChunks: The age of AI that just talks is over,

people.name: 다리오 아모데이
people.quote: AI는 인류가 맞이한 가장 위대한 기회이고, 동시에 가장 치명적인 위협입니다.
people.quoteEn: People underestimate how radical the upside is, and how bad the risks
people.quoteOrigin: I think that most people are underestimating just how radical the upside of AI could be, just as I think most people are underestimating how bad the risks could be
linesEn: Former OpenAI VP of Research, led GPT-2 & GPT-3

people.name: 다니엘라 아모데이
people.quote: AI는 미친 듯이 달리는데, 우리가 적응할 시간은 턱없이 부족합니다.
people.quoteEn: The worst outcome: we saw the transformation coming, and gave people no time to adapt.
people.quoteOrigin: We do know that this is coming incredibly quickly. The worst version of outcomes would be we knew there was going to be this incredible transformation, and people did not have enough of an opportunity to adapt.
quoteEnChunks: The worst outcome: we saw the transformation coming,
and gave people no time to adapt.
linesEn: Former OpenAI VP of Safety & Policy

people.name: 잭 클락
people.quote: 뻔한 기계가 아닌, 예측 불가능한 생명입니다.
people.quoteEn: Not a simple, predictable machine. A real, mysterious creature.
people.quoteOrigin: But make no mistake: what we are dealing with is a real and mysterious creature, not a simple and predictable machine
linesEn: Former OpenAI Policy Director, ex-Bloomberg reporter

people.name: 크리스 올라
people.quote: 그들은 우리가 상상한 기계가 아니었습니다. 창조한 우리조차 그들을 설명하지 못합니다.
people.quoteEn: They are not the cold calculating robots we were promised
people.quoteOrigin: They are not the cold calculating robots we were promised. They remain mysterious even to those of us who create them.

people.name: 샘 맥캔들리시
people.quote: 솟구치는 위협에 대한 안전 기준은 저희가 최대한 격상시켜두겠습니다.
people.quoteEn: We built our Safety Levels to reflect the risk
people.quoteOrigin: There is always some level of arbitrariness in drawing boundaries, but we wanted to roughly reflect different tiers of risk

people.name: 톰 브라운
people.quote: 오늘 못찾은 값은 내일 더 큰 연산으로 찾아내면 됩니다.
people.quoteEn: Today it gets stuck, but more compute makes it smarter
people.quoteOrigin: Right now you may prompt the model to build a successful startup. It'll try to do it, but it'll get stuck. But as we add more compute, the model gets smarter.

people.name: 재러드 카플란
people.quote: 우리가 재귀 개선을 승인하는 날, 궁극의 위험이 시작됩니다.
people.quoteEn: The day we let them improve themselves, the ultimate risk begins.
people.quoteOrigin: Recursive self-improvement is in some ways the ultimate risk, because it's like letting the AI go
linesEn: Former OpenAI, GPT-3 & Scaling Laws co-author

people.name: 안드레이 카파시
people.quote: 앞으로 몇 년은 LLM의 가장 결정적인 시기가 될 겁니다.
people.quoteOrigin: I think the next few years at the frontier of LLMs will be especially formative.
people.quoteEn: The next few years at the frontier of LLMs will be especially formative.
linesEn: OpenAI founding member · led Tesla Autopilot

people.name: 얀 라이케
people.quote: 최근의 업계는 반짝이는 제품만 중요했고, 안전과 프로세스는 뒷전이었습니다. 다시 집중해야 합니다.
people.quoteOrigin: Over the past years, safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products.
people.quoteEn: Over the past years, safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products.
quoteEnChunks: Over the past years, safety culture and processes have taken a backseat to shiny products.

people.name: 로스 노딘
linesEn: Co-founded xAI · designed datacenter power strategy

people.name: 일론 머스크
people.quote: 최대한의 진실을 추구하는 AI만이 인류와 함께 우주의 본질로 나아갈 수 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: AI should be maximally truth-seeking, even if politically incorrect
people.quoteOrigin: maximally truth-seeking AI, even if that truth is sometimes at odds with what is politically correct
linesEn: Built Grok, acquired X for data

people.name: 마이클 니콜스
people.quote: 두 달 동안 연산 효율 다섯 배를 높여서 업계를 바짝 추격하겠습니다.
people.quoteEn: We're behind. In two months, we push efficiency to 50 percent.
people.quoteOrigin: Our MFU is at an embarrassingly low 11 percent, far below the 35 to 45 percent industry standard. The target is to reach 50 percent.

people.name: 데벤드라 차플로트
people.quote: X는 물리적 지능과 디지털 지능을 하나로 결합하고 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: Beyond digital intelligence, toward physical intelligence
people.quoteOrigin: Together SpaceX and xAI combine physical and digital intelligence under a leader who understands hardware at the deepest level

people.name: 앤드루 밀리치
people.quote: X는 공상과학을 현실로 만듭니다. 재사용 로켓, 휴머노이드, 우주 데이터센터, 그리고 그 너머까지도.
people.quoteEn: X is the company realizing science fiction - reusable rockets, humanoid robots, data centers in space, and more
people.quoteOrigin: X is the company realizing science fiction - reusable rockets, humanoid robots, data centers in space, and more

people.name: 제이슨 긴스버그
people.quote: X는 인간의 자유를 바탕으로, AI의 잠든 지능을 깨우고, 우주로 진출해 아직 누구도 보지 못한 가능성을 현실로 만들어갈 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: Now, we get to work on intelligence, understanding, and freedom on a universal scale.
people.quoteOrigin: Now, we get to work on intelligence, understanding, and freedom on a universal scale.
quoteEnChunks: Now, we get to work on

people.quote: 빠르게 움직여라. 주변의 모든 게 박살나고 있지 않다면 아직 느린 것이다.
people.quoteEn: Move fast and break things; if nothing breaks, you're too slow
people.quoteOrigin: Move fast and break things. Unless you are breaking stuff, you are not moving fast enough.
quoteChunks: 빠르게 움직여라. 주변의 모든 게 박살나고 있지 않다면 아직 느린 것이다.
quoteEnChunks: if nothing breaks, you're too slow
linesEn: Built Superintelligence Labs as his all-in bet

people.name: 알렉산더 왕
people.quote: 표적도 AI가 고르고 방아쇠도 AI가 당깁니다. 우린 이미 AI 전쟁의 한가운데에 들어서 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: AI picks the targets, AI pulls the trigger. We're already in the middle of an AI war.
people.quoteOrigin: Lethal drones with facial recognition, armed robots, autonomous fighter jets: we're at the dawn of a new age of AI-powered warfare.
quoteChunks: 표적도 AI가 고르고 방아쇠도 AI가 당깁니다. 우린 이미 AI 전쟁의 한가운데에 들어서 있습니다.
quoteEnChunks: We're already in the middle of an AI war.

people.name: 냇 프리드먼
people.quote: 인간을 가로막는 유일한 한계는 물리 법칙뿐, 나머지 모든 것은 허상입니다.
people.quoteEn: The only limit holding us back is the laws of physics. Everything else is an illusion.
people.quoteOrigin: You can do more than you think. We are tied down by invisible orthodoxy. The laws of physics are the only limit.
quoteChunks: 인간을 가로막는 유일한 한계는 물리 법칙뿐, 나머지 모든 것은 허상입니다.
quoteEnChunks: The only limit holding us back
linesEn: Drove Copilot, ushering in AI coding

people.name: 셩지아 자오
people.quote: 초지능을 만들되, 인간을 지원하도록 맞추겠습니다.
people.quoteEn: Build superintelligence, and align it to empower people
people.quoteOrigin: Looking forward to building asi and aligning it to empower people with the amazing team here
linesEn: Co-created ChatGPT and GPT-4 at OpenAI

people.name: 다니엘 그로스
people.quote: 우리가 짓는 건 지능 공장입니다. 세상은 지금 지능에 굶주려 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: What we're building is a factory for intelligence. The world is starving for it.
people.quoteOrigin: what we're trying to make here is a factory for intelligence, there's clear market demand for intelligence.
quoteChunks: 우리가 짓는 건 지능 공장입니다. 세상은 지금 지능에 굶주려 있습니다.
quoteEnChunks: The world is starving for it.

people.name: 정형원
people.quote: 세상이 곧 완전히 뒤바뀔 텐데도, 사람들은 지금의 삶과 익숙한 질서가 앞으로도 영원할 것처럼 살아갑니다.
people.quoteEn: Instead of chasing the latest development, study the change itself.
people.quoteOrigin: Instead of spending all our energy catching up with the latest development, we should study the change itself

Ex-Google Brain · led PaLM and Flan

people.name: 아르투르 멘쉬
people.quote: 이건 칩을 쥔 자, 전력을 쥔 자가 이기는 싸움입니다.
people.quoteEn: This is a fight won by whoever controls the chips and the power.
people.quoteOrigin: Whoever controls the chips, whoever controls the electrons, whoever has massive access to energy — that's who wins.
quoteChunks: 이건 칩을 쥔 자, 전력을 쥔 자가 이기는 싸움입니다.
quoteEnChunks: This is a fight won by

people.name: 기욤 람플
people.quote: 작은 모델 하나를 잘 빚어내서 거대 기업 여럿을 박살낼 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: A small, well-tuned model can match the giants.
people.quoteOrigin: In practice, the huge majority of enterprise use cases are things that can be tackled by small models, especially if you fine-tune them. In many cases, you can actually match or even out-perform closed-source models.
linesEn: Ex-Meta FAIR, senior author of LLaMA

people.name: 티모테 라크루아
people.quote: 최고의 속도를 뽑아내려면 모든 장비와 케이블 한 가닥을 직접 구성해야 합니다.
people.quoteEn: We don't just build models. We build the stack beneath them.
people.quoteOrigin: We started as a company that built models. To address the need for stability, we saw a way for us to basically build our own data centers and maintain them with our understanding of what quality looks like.
quoteChunks: 최고의 속도를 뽑아내려면 모든 장비와 케이블 한 가닥을 직접 구성해야 합니다.

people.name: 클레망 들랑그
people.quote: 권력이 한 곳에 쏠리면 혁신은 위축됩니다. 우린 개방으로 세상의 균형을 되찾겠습니다.
people.quoteEn: When power pools in one place, innovation withers. Through openness, we restore the world's balance.
people.quoteOrigin: Open-science and open-source foster innovation and fair competition, giving civil society, academia and policy makers the capabilities they need to counterbalance the power of big private companies.
quoteChunks: 권력이 한 곳에 쏠리면 혁신은 위축됩니다. 우린 개방으로 세상의 균형을 되찾겠습니다.
quoteEnChunks: When power pools in one place, innovation withers.

people.name: 줄리앙 쇼몽
people.quote: 허깅페이스의 얼굴은 AI가 인간에게 건네는 첫인사입니다. 포옹이라는 가장 인간다운 방식으로요.
people.quoteEn: The Hugging Face is AI's first greeting to humanity, a hug, the most human gesture of all.
people.quoteOrigin: The Hugging Face emoji has human features and is doing a human gesture, giving a hug. So it's bridging between machines and humans in a way.
quoteChunks: 허깅페이스의 얼굴은 AI가 인간에게 건네는 첫인사입니다. 포옹이라는 가장 인간다운 방식으로요.
quoteEnChunks: The Hugging Face is AI's first greeting to humanity,
the most human gesture of all.

people.name: 토마스 울프
people.quote: 모든 답을 아는 AI가 아닌, 엉뚱한 질문을 던지는 AI만이 AGI로 나아갑니다.
people.quoteEn: We don't need a machine that knows every answer, but one that asks the question no one dared to.
people.quoteOrigin: To create an Einstein in a data center, we don't just need a system that knows all the answers, but rather one that can ask questions nobody else has thought of or dared to ask.
quoteChunks: 모든 답을 아는 AI가 아닌, 엉뚱한 질문을 던지는 AI만이 AGI로 나아갑니다.

the question no one dared to.

people.name: 량원펑
people.quote: 진짜 격차는 원조냐 모방이냐에 있습니다. 이걸 못 바꾸면 중국은 영원히 남들 뒤만 쫓을 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: The real gap is between originality and imitation. If that doesn't change, China will always be a follower.
quoteChunks: 진짜 격차는 원조냐 모방이냐에 있습니다. 이걸 못 바꾸면 중국은 영원히 남들 뒤만 쫓을 겁니다.
quoteEnChunks: The real gap is between originality and imitation.
China will always be a follower.
people.quoteOrigin: The real gap is the difference between originality and imitation. If this doesn't change, China will always be only a follower.

people.name: 양즈린
people.quote: 향후 10년, 중요한 건 오직 AGI 뿐입니다.
people.quoteEn: AGI is the only thing that matters over the next decade.
linesEn: Ex-Google Brain, lead author of XLNet

people.name: 알렉 래드포드
linesEn: Effectively the architect of the GPT lineage

people.name: 일리야 수츠케버
people.quote: 지금 신경망 안에서 의식이라 부를 만한 무언가가 조금씩 눈을 뜨고 있습니다.
people.quoteEn: Right now, inside that neural network, something we might call consciousness is slowly opening its eyes.
quoteEnChunks: Right now, inside that neural network,
people.quoteOrigin: It may be that today's large neural networks are slightly conscious.

people.name: 다니엘 레비
linesEn: SSI co-founder grounded in optimization research
people.quote: 우린 눈앞의 돈에 안전을 팔지 않을 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: No distractions. We never trade safety for short-term money.
quoteEnChunks: We never trade safety for short-term money.
people.quoteOrigin: Our singular focus means no distraction by management overhead or product cycles, and our business model means safety, security, and progress are all insulated from short-term commercial pressures.

people.name: 미라 무라티
people.quote: 우리가 너무 일찍 고삐를 놔버린다면 AI가 그리는 미래는 훨씬 끔찍할 겁니다.
quoteChunks: 우리가 너무 일찍 고삐를 놔버린다면 AI가 그리는 미래는 훨씬 끔찍할 겁니다.
people.quoteEn: If humans take their hands off the wheel too soon, the future looks very different. And not better.
quoteEnChunks: If humans take their hands off the wheel too soon,
the future looks very different. And not better.
people.quoteOrigin: If humans take their hands off the wheel too soon, the future will look very different, and not better.
